notes: «قال قرأت على مالك» : the one read to is a link, as with «سمعت X» (rule 5)
«عيسى بن، طلحة بن عبيد الله»: a stray comma inside one name, kept as written: one man, one link (rule 9)
«قال وقف رسول الله» : the Companion's own words relay the saying, so he is the last link
